maintenance_items.label: Chain (Clean and lube)
maintenance_items.description: The chain is the component that suffers the most wear. Regular lubrication extends its life and prevents dangerous breakage.

maintenance_items.label: Brake pads
maintenance_items.description: Friction compound wears with use. Below 1.5mm thickness, safety is compromised.

maintenance_items.label: Brake fluid
maintenance_items.description: Brake fluid is hygroscopic: it absorbs moisture, reducing its boiling point and braking effectiveness.

maintenance_items.label: Tire pressure and condition
maintenance_items.description: Tires degrade both by mileage and age. Incorrect pressure or uneven wear compromises grip and safety.

maintenance_items.label: Fork oil
maintenance_items.description: Over time it breaks down, losing density and worsening front suspension behavior.

maintenance_items.label: Chassis & wheel bearings
maintenance_items.description: Check for play or roughness in wheel hubs, steering head bearings, and swingarm pivot.

maintenance_items.label: Cables & controls
maintenance_items.description: Lubricate clutch and throttle cables. Verify correct free play on levers and pedals.
